description: Partial advisory checks for the pinned Munchkin165 visitWebPage/clickLink query producer on mktoresp.com and its tenant subdomains. Exact _mchVr=165 plus the generated _mchNc carrier select this profile. Three stable location-key presences and captured GET/POST transport are checked. IDs, tokens, URL/link values, coercion branches, other versions and receiver acceptance remain open; the loader is not a collector.

params.name: _mchVr
params.description: The literal version marker identifies the pinned producer only. This is selection evidence, not a receiver-wide version enum.

params.name: _mchNc
params.description: The source emits this query carrier in the generated route. Values remain open, with no timestamp spelling, time-window or cache-uniqueness rule.

params.name: _mchHo
params.description: The actual x constructor supplies the current page hostname before Q serializes it. Only key presence is advised; repeated or empty configured values remain open.

params.name: _mchPo
params.description: The actual constructor supplies the page port, commonly an empty string. No nonempty or numeric-port grammar is imposed.

params.name: _mchPc
params.description: The actual constructor supplies the page protocol. Only key presence is advised, without an inferred scheme enum or HTTPS-only requirement.

params.name: method
params.description: Q uses bodyless sendBeacon POST, or GET through XHR/image fallback. No body or MIME requirement is imposed.
